'''Identifier''' was a [[Subnode|subsystem]] of the [[Assembler]] known as [[Kud'ar Mub'at]]. It was charged with identifying objects and individuals,<ref name="EGTAS">''[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|The Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> such as [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and visitors to the Assembler's [[Ghostling Nest of the Assembler|web]] before they reached the outer defenses.
